description: About recHERsion recHERsion 2026 is the flagship women-only hackathon organised by ACM-W, NITK Surathkal , as part of Engineer NITK 2K26 , the institute's annual technical fest. This 24-hour online hackathon aims to empower women in technology by providing a platform to innovate, collaborate and develop practical, technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges. Tracks and Problem Statements Participants will be provided with three problem statements centred on key societal challenges, covering domains such as: Women's Safety: Personal safety, emergency response, cyber harassment and safer public spaces. Healthcare: Menstrual health, maternal care, reproductive health and mental well-being. Sustainability and Climate: Sustainable solutions addressing climate challenges affecting women. Accessibility: Assistive technologies and improved access to essential services. Education: Digital literacy, STEM education and equal learning opportunities. Financial Inclusion: Financial literacy, entrepreneurship and economic independence for women. Hackathon Format 1. Registration and Team Formation: Participants register in teams of 2–3 members . Inter-college teams are allowed. 2. Prototype Development: Teams develop functional prototypes addressing their selected problem statements using suitable technologies and tools. 3. Final Presentation and Evaluation: Teams demonstrate their prototypes before a judging panel. Evaluation will consider innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, problem relevance and potential impact. Event Details Dates: 24–25 October 2026 Duration: 24 hours Mode: Online Organiser: ACM-W, NITK Surathkal Part of: Engineer NITK 2K26 Eligibility: Open to women students Team Size: 2–3 members; inter-college teams permitted Build. Innovate. Empower. Join recHERsion 2026 to transform ideas into impactful solutions, collaborate with fellow innovators and use technology to address challenges that matter.

raw.details:
About recHERsion

recHERsion 2026 is the flagship women-only hackathon organised by ACM-W, NITK Surathkal, as part of Engineer NITK 2K26, the institute's annual technical fest.

This 24-hour online hackathon aims to empower women in technology by providing a platform to innovate, collaborate and develop practical, technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.

Tracks and Problem Statements

Participants will be provided with three problem statements centred on key societal challenges, covering domains such as:

  • Women's Safety: Personal safety, emergency response, cyber harassment and safer public spaces.
  • Healthcare: Menstrual health, maternal care, reproductive health and mental well-being.
  • Sustainability and Climate: Sustainable solutions addressing climate challenges affecting women.
  • Accessibility: Assistive technologies and improved access to essential services.
  • Education: Digital literacy, STEM education and equal learning opportunities.
  • Financial Inclusion: Financial literacy, entrepreneurship and economic independence for women.

Hackathon Format

1. Registration and Team Formation: Participants register in teams of 2–3 members. Inter-college teams are allowed.

2. Prototype Development: Teams develop functional prototypes addressing their selected problem statements using suitable technologies and tools.

3. Final Presentation and Evaluation: Teams demonstrate their prototypes before a judging panel. Evaluation will consider innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, problem relevance and potential impact.

Event Details

  • Dates: 24–25 October 2026
  • Duration: 24 hours
  • Mode: Online
  • Organiser: ACM-W, NITK Surathkal
  • Part of: Engineer NITK 2K26
  • Eligibility: Open to women students 
  • Team Size: 2–3 members; inter-college teams permitted

Build. Innovate. Empower.

Join recHERsion 2026 to transform ideas into impactful solutions, collaborate with fellow innovators and use technology to address challenges that matter.
